documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported a strong start to FY27 with revenue growth of 27%, EBITDA growth of 55%, and PAT growth of 64% year-on-year for the first quarter. Management noted that construction equipment momentum remains robust while large agricultural equipment is at its cyclical bottom. The company maintained a strong net cash position of approximately INR190 crores and is actively evaluating inorganic acquisition opportunities in hydraulics, PTOs, and fabrications. Uniparts India reported its Q1 FY27 results with a revenue growth of 27% year-on-year, EBITDA growth of 55% year-on-year, and PAT growth of 64% year-on-year. Management noted that construction equipment demand remains healthy, small agriculture is seeing early signs of volume recovery, large agriculture is at a cyclical bottom, and the aftermarket segment was flat due to tariff-driven price volatility.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: North America small agriculture is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading original equipment manufacturers indicate that calendar year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom for large agricultural equipment, with recovery expected in calendar year 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: After 3 consecutive years of volume decline in small agricultural equipment, unit volumes are beginning to recover.
demand_outlook.quote: After 3 consecutive years of volume decline, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending under technology investments in the U.S. and government-led investments in Europe are sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused demand skewing and moderated purchasing in the aftermarket business.
demand_outlook.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

demand_outlook.claim: New business wins in India in the small ag segment have been particularly strong.
demand_outlook.quote: New business wins in India in the small ag segment have been particularly strong.

demand_outlook.claim: In Western markets, small ag growth remains more measured.
demand_outlook.quote: In Western markets, small ag growth remains more measured.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalise and the segment to return to growth.
demand_outlook.quote: With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalise and the segment to return to growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment in North America.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The European construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule with uninterrupted customer supply.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule. And I'm pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations remain on track for initial customer deliveries from the warehouse in the third quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the first quarter of FY27 was INR12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule, and I am pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of materials for the quarter was reported at 33.3%, driven largely by product mix changes.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: Material cost is typically in the range of 34% to 37% for the business.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: The company delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% for quarter 4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management has stated consistently that a 20% EBITDA margin is sustainable over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Aftermarket business accounted for approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR 225 crores, growing over 12.5% quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: New business awards were over INR 225 crores in annualized potential over the last 12 months.
orders_capacity.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of the first quarter stood at approximately INR190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Organic capital expenditure requirements for the business are roughly 2.5% to 3.5% of total revenue.
capital_allocation.quote: today, our capex requirements as a business are roughly about 2.5% to 3.5% of our total revenue.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Just to put this in context, when we declared the special dividend of INR101 crores in October of '25, our cash balance was approximately INR210 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of cash generation.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The balance sheet is in excellent health, and the company continues to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate its strategic agenda.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR 160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR 170 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation continues to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

risks_headwinds.claim: One of the facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incident in the finishing shop toward the end of quarter 3.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

management_commitments.claim: Mexico warehouse operations will generate mid-single-digit million-dollar revenue levels in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

management_commitments.claim: The fabrication vertical will become a meaningful vertical within the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: The aftermarket segment will normalize and return to growth over the next 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: And I think over the next 12 months, we do expect this to normalize.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects normal operations to return on schedule regarding the Ludhiana facility rebuilding effort.
management_commitments.quote: And in parallel, the rebuilding effort is well underway. The incident is fully covered under our insurance policy and the claim was filed during the quarter. We expect normal operations to return on schedule.
